title: Desktop tooling: working ESLint + contract rules, Turbopack production build, gate runner, stack launcher, layout probe
goal: ESLint runs with the contract rules (plus a new raw-palette rule) under a per-file ratchet; `npm run build` works; every later batch gets one command to start an isolated stack (`fix-stack.mjs`), one to run its gates (`fix-gates.mjs`) and one to check layout (`layout-probe.mjs`).
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Root cause BUG-037: desktop/eslint.config.mjs uses FlatCompat (`compat.extends('next/core-web-vitals','next/typescript','prettier')`) which crashes with "Converting circular structure to JSON ... property 'react' closes the circle" in @eslint/eslintrc. eslint 9.39.3 and eslint-config-next 16.1.6 are hoisted to the repo-root node_modules; eslint-config-next 16 exports NATIVE flat configs (`eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals`, `eslint-config-next/typescript`, each an array) and eslint-config-prettier exports `eslint-config-prettier/flat`. `"lint": "next lint"` no longer exists in Next 16. The planner probed a native config over src/: 1216 errors (817 @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, 276 no-restricted-syntax = contract rules 1/3, 109 no-unused-vars, ~13 react-hooks/* and misc) and 5142 warnings (jsx-no-literals, import/order) across 200 files - so "0 errors" is impossible now; the gate is a per-file RATCHET: no file may gain errors, owned files must reach 0, and B30 drives the total to 0. Raw Tailwind palette classes (bg-gray-100, text-orange-600, from-primary-400 ...; ~600 sites) are not caught by any current rule although CONTRACT section 3 requires ds tokens - add a rule now so the ratchet tracks them. Root cause BUG-038: `next build` defaults to Turbopack in Next 16 and fails on the custom `webpack()` in next.config.ts ("Call retries were exceeded"); `next build --webpack` succeeds (the remake pipeline used it). OWNER DECISION (2026-10-03): MIGRATE production builds to Turbopack. `npm run build` must be plain `next build` (Turbopack, the Next 16 default) and must succeed. Verified failure today: "This build is using Turbopack, with a `webpack` config and no `turbopack` config" then "Call retries were exceeded". The custom webpack() hook in next.config.ts only sets client fallbacks fs/path/os=false; replace it with the Turbopack equivalent (turbopack.resolveAlias with a browser-conditional empty module, e.g. { fs: { browser: "./src/lib/empty-module.ts" } }) ONLY if a client bundle actually imports those modules - check first; otherwise delete the hook and set `turbopack: {}`. Keep output: standalone (Electron packaging). Existing baselines to encode in gate-baseline.json: tsc 99 errors (0 in app src, 97 in unit tests, 2 in e2e); vitest 10 failing files = src/lib/api/{ai,auth,chatbot,client,credit-notes,exports,marketing,payments,users,vouchers}.test.ts; backend vitest baseline 901 passed; e2e baseline = desktop/audit/fix/e2e-parsed.json (shape: {failed, passed, ..., failures:[{idx,test:"<file>:<line>:<col> > ...",error,run,bug,kind}]}).
steps: Rewrite desktop/eslint.config.mjs: delete FlatCompat and the dirname/fileURLToPath boilerplate; `import nextVitals from 'eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals'; import nextTs from 'eslint-config-next/typescript'; import prettier from 'eslint-config-prettier/flat';` and start the array with `...nextVitals, ...nextTs, prettier,`. Keep every existing custom block (strict TS rules, contract rules 1-4, exemptions) unchanged except as below.

Contract rule for palette classes: add `const RAW_PALETTE_RE = String.raw`... (write it as a normal string) matching `\b(?:bg|text|border|from|via|to|ring|fill|stroke|divide|outline|decoration|shadow|accent|caret|placeholder)-(?:slate|gray|zinc|neutral|stone|red|orange|amber|yellow|lime|green|emerald|teal|cyan|sky|blue|indigo|violet|purple|fuchsia|pink|rose|primary)-\d{2,3}\b` and add two selectors (Literal[value=/.../] and TemplateElement[value.raw=/.../]) to the SAME `no-restricted-syntax` entry as rules 1/3 (flat config replaces rule options, it does not merge). Message: "Raw Tailwind palette classes are not allowed. Use ds-* token classes (CONTRACT.md section 3)." Verify the selector compiles: `echo "export const x = 'bg-gray-100';" | npx eslint --stdin --stdin-filename src/x.tsx` reports it.

Exempt block (tests/configs/e2e): also set `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: off` and `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars: warn` for `**/*.test.{ts,tsx}`, `e2e/**/*.ts`, `**/*.config.{ts,mjs,js}`. Global ignores: `.next/**, out/**, node_modules/**, electron/**, playwright-report/**, test-results/**, audit/**, showcase/**, storybook-static/**, coverage/**, scripts/**, next-env.d.ts`.

desktop/package.json scripts: "lint": "eslint .", "lint:gate": "node scripts/lint-gate.mjs", "build": "next build", "build:electron": "next build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json", "gates": "node scripts/fix-gates.mjs". Do not add dependencies.

Migrate desktop/next.config.ts to Turbopack: remove the webpack() hook (see context), add `turbopack` config (resolveAlias only if needed), keep output standalone / images / transpilePackages. Run `npx next build` and fix any remaining Turbopack build error at its root (read the full build log; check transpilePackages @travelcrm/shared resolution, server-only imports in client components, dynamic requires). Then `npx next start -p 3100` and smoke /login and /dashboard. playwright.config.ts / playwright.showcase.config.ts are OUT of scope (B09 / showcase own them). If after genuine investigation the Turbopack build cannot pass, STOP and report the exact error - do not fall back to --webpack.

Create desktop/scripts/lint-gate.mjs (ESM, Node 22): use the ESLint Node API (`import { ESLint } from 'eslint'`, cwd = desktop) to lint `.`; build a map relPosixPath -> errorCount (severity 2 only) and per-rule totals. Modes: default = compare with desktop/audit/fix/lint-baseline.json ({generatedAt,totalErrors,files:{path:count}}) and FAIL (exit 1) if any file count > baseline or a file missing from the baseline has errors; print improved files and new total. `--update` = rewrite the baseline. `--zero <glob> [<glob>...]` = additionally FAIL if any file matching the globs has >= 1 error (implement globs with a small glob->RegExp helper supporting **, *, {a,b}; no new deps). `--json <file>` = write summary. Generate the initial baseline with `--update`.

Create desktop/audit/fix/gate-baseline.json: {"tscTestErrors":99,"tscSrcErrors":0,"vitestFailingFiles":["src/lib/api/ai.test.ts","src/lib/api/auth.test.ts","src/lib/api/chatbot.test.ts","src/lib/api/client.test.ts","src/lib/api/credit-notes.test.ts","src/lib/api/exports.test.ts","src/lib/api/marketing.test.ts","src/lib/api/payments.test.ts","src/lib/api/users.test.ts","src/lib/api/vouchers.test.ts"],"backendPassedMin":901,"e2eBaseline":"audit/fix/e2e-parsed.json"}. The orchestrator ratchets these numbers down after each merge.

Create desktop/scripts/fix-stack.mjs (Windows-first, cross-platform): `up|down|status [--slot N] [--reset-db] [--no-build]`. Slot N -> API port 8787+10N, web port 3100+10N. `up`: (1) in ../backend write `.wrangler-e2e.toml` = wrangler.toml with the `[ai]` section stripped (same logic as desktop/playwright.config.ts webServer); (2) if --reset-db or ../backend/.wrangler/state/v3/d1 does not exist: delete that dir, run `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply travelcrm-master --local -c .wrangler-e2e.toml` (env CI=1 to skip prompts) then `node scripts/seed-local.mjs`; (3) spawn detached `npx wrangler dev --port <api> -c .wrangler-e2e.toml --var TEST_MODE:true --var SENDGRID_API_KEY: --var TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: --var TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN: --var TWILIO_VERIFY_SERVICE_SID:` (stdout/stderr -> desktop/audit/fix/stack/slot<N>-api.log), poll http://localhost:<api>/api/v1/health (90s); (4) unless --no-build run `npm run build` with env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:<api>/api/v1; (5) spawn `npx next start -p <web>` (same env, log slot<N>-web.log), poll http://localhost:<web>/login; (6) write pids + ports to desktop/audit/fix/stack/slot<N>.json and print `E2E_BASE_URL=... E2E_API_URL=...`. `down`: kill the process trees (`taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F` on win32, process group kill elsewhere). Use `shell: true` spawns on Windows. Check backend/scripts/seed-local.mjs for how it calls wrangler (pass the same config if it needs one).

Create desktop/scripts/layout-probe.mjs (uses `chromium` from '@playwright/test'): args --base (default from slot file or http://localhost:3100), --api, --routes a,b,c | --routes-file, --viewports 1366x768,1920x1080, --themes light,dark, --out <dir>, --warn-only. Auth: POST <api>/auth/login {email:'admin@demo.com',password:'Admin@123',tenantId:'01960000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001'} and inject the result into localStorage key 'travelcrm-auth' using exactly the persisted shape of src/stores/auth-store.ts (read its persist/partialize), plus next-themes key 'theme' = light|dark, via context.addInitScript. Per route x viewport x theme: goto, wait for networkidle (cap 15s), screenshot, and check: (1) pageerror + console.error; (2) responses >= 400 (record; 403 on /admin/* is informational); (3) horizontal overflow `main.scrollWidth > main.clientWidth + 1`; (4) gutter: left of the first visible h1 minus left of <main> >= 16 and the right edge of `[data-slot=page-container]` (or h1 parent) <= main right - 16; (5) nested scrollers inside main: elements whose computed overflow-y is auto|scroll and scrollHeight > clientHeight + 4, EXCLUDING `[data-scroll-region]`, `[role=dialog]`, `[role=listbox]`, `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]`, textarea, pre; (6) empty top-bar title (`header h2` trimmed text); (7) sidebar active items `aside [aria-current=page]` count != 1 (warning). Write <out>/probe.json and exit 1 if any of checks 1,3,4,5,6 fail unless --warn-only.

Create desktop/scripts/fix-gates.mjs: `node scripts/fix-gates.mjs <BATCH_ID> [--slot N] [--skip a,b]`. Load desktop/audit/fix/batches/<BATCH_ID>-*.json and run the gates it enables, in order typecheck, unit, lint, build, backendTests, flutter, specs, layoutProbe: typecheck = `npx tsc --noEmit`, parse `error TS` lines, FAIL if any error is in a file under src/ that is not *.test.*, or if test/e2e error count > gate-baseline.tscTestErrors; unit = `npx vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=audit/fix/gates/<id>-vitest.json`, FAIL if a failing file is not in gate-baseline.vitestFailingFiles; lint = `node scripts/lint-gate.mjs` plus `--zero` with gates.lintZero if present; build = `npm run build`; backendTests = `npx vitest run` in ../backend, parse "Test Files" and "Tests" summary lines, FAIL on any failed file or passed < backendPassedMin; flutter = run `C:/Windows/SysWOW64/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe -Command "cd <abs>/packages/driver_app; flutter analyze; flutter test"` (FAIL on non-zero or "issues found"); specs = `npx playwright test <specs> --reporter=line` with E2E_BASE_URL/E2E_API_URL from the slot file; a failing test is tolerated only if it appears in gates.allowedSpecFailures; layoutProbe = run layout-probe.mjs with gates.layoutProbe routes - resolve placeholders like <contactId>, <leadId>, <itineraryId>, <invoiceId>, <tripId> ... by querying the matching list endpoint (limit=1) on the slot API and caching the ids in desktop/audit/fix/probe-ids.json (skip a route with a warning if no record exists); the value ["ALL"] means every page.tsx route under src/app/(app) with [id] segments resolved the same way. Write desktop/audit/fix/gates/<BATCH_ID>.json {gate:{status,durationMs,tail}} where tail = LAST 80 lines of output (never the head), and print a summary table. Exit 1 if any gate fails.

Verify: `npx eslint src/app/layout.tsx` runs (no crash); `npm run lint` runs ESLint (non-zero exit expected, errors listed); `node scripts/lint-gate.mjs --update && node scripts/lint-gate.mjs` passes; `npm run build` succeeds; `node scripts/fix-stack.mjs up --slot 0` then `node scripts/layout-probe.mjs --routes /dashboard,/contacts --warn-only --out audit/fix/probe/B00` produces probe.json + screenshots; `node scripts/fix-stack.mjs down --slot 0`; `node scripts/fix-gates.mjs B00 --skip specs,layoutProbe` writes gates/B00.json.
acceptance: `npx eslint src/app/layout.tsx` and `npm run lint` execute ESLint without a config crash.
A string literal containing `bg-gray-100` in a src/*.tsx file is reported by no-restricted-syntax with the palette message; a file under src/design-system/ is not.
`npm run build` (plain `next build`, Turbopack) succeeds; `next start` serves /login and /dashboard; next.config.ts has no webpack() hook; standalone output still produced.
`node scripts/lint-gate.mjs` exits 0 against the freshly generated lint-baseline.json and exits 1 if you temporarily add an `any` to a clean file (revert after).
`node scripts/fix-stack.mjs up --slot 0` brings up API :8787 (health 200) and web :3100 (/login 200); `down` kills both.
layout-probe.mjs writes probe.json with all 7 checks for /dashboard at both viewports and both themes.
fix-gates.mjs B00 writes desktop/audit/fix/gates/B00.json containing output tails.
notes: This batch defines the tooling all later gates use; keep scripts dependency-free (node built-ins + packages already installed: eslint, @playwright/test). If a check in layout-probe proves noisy on a correct page, make it a warning rather than dropping it, and document the threshold in the script header.
